subject: Generating multiple mainPanels from a for loop

messages.author: 236aa224306b9a87
messages.subject: Generating multiple mainPanels from a for loop
parts:
Hi, I might be stretching the limits or capabilities of Shiny, but I was wondering whether it is possible to generate multiple mainPanels in succession, each as an iteration of a for loop.

For example, say I have the following ui.R:

shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  headerPanel('My Shiny App'),
  
  mainPanel(
    tableOutput("test")
  )
))

and the following server.R:

shinyServer(function(input, output){

  output$test <- renderTable({
    for(i in 1:3){
      mtcars.row <- mtcars[i,]
      return(mtcars.row)
    }})

  }) 

What I'm trying to achieve with this example is to display three mainPanels (one for each iteration of the for loop). Each mainPanel would display one row of mtcars. With the example above, all that is output is the first row of mtcars (and not the following two under it). I don't want to simply return a data.frame of the first three rows; I need each row separate from the others. Is this possible?

Thanks!

Alan

messages.subject: Re: Generating multiple mainPanels from a for loop

I don't think you want multiple mainPanels, just multiple tableOutputs
within one mainPanel... right?

Try this gist:
https://gist.github.com/jcheng5/5616777
